chunks: From him, from Muhammad, from Saif, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: Casting the stones (at the Jamarat) is [permitted] from the rising of the sun until its setting.

key_terms.رَمْيُ الْجِمَارِ: Casting of stones (ritual act in Hajj)

ai.seo_question: What is the valid time period for casting the Jamarat stones during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani’s chain in *al-Ishtibār* clarifies the temporal window for Ramy al-Jimar during the Days of Tashriq, affirming it as a continuous act permissible from sunrise to sunset. In Shia jurisprudence, this supports the view that the stoning is not restricted to a specific hour but constitutes a valid ritual throughout the daylight hours of the 11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah, emphasizing the flexibility within the prescribed rites of Hajj.
